# Wintech Studio

> Design and build studio in Lagos, Nigeria, founded by Oladele Ibraheem. One team for brand, websites and stores, AI assistants, automation, apps and MVPs, and motion.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.wintechstudio.com
- Email: hello@wintechstudio.com
- WhatsApp: +234 913 407 1813

## Services
- Brand and packaging: from $1,500 (₦1,000,000), 3 to 4 weeks
- Websites and stores: from $1,200 (₦900,000), 2 to 6 weeks
- AI assistant: from $1,800 + $60/month (₦1,200,000 + ₦50,000/month), 4 to 6 weeks
- Automation: quoted per workflow, 2 to 4 weeks
- Apps and MVPs: from $4,000 (₦3,000,000), 4 to 8 weeks
- Motion and film: from $650 (₦500,000), 1 to 3 weeks

## Products
- Wintech Templates: website templates for Nigerian businesses at https://app.wintechstudio.com
